description:
1. Buttons should be our yellow color with hover as found on all add to cart sections on our website. Remove orange color.


2. All numbers should be Roboto font, just as we did on our previous job for product pages add to cart sections. Example: https://www.mybrightcore.com/products/multi-collagen-protein


3. Page will need to auto calculate just as on Humann website. Once the customer clicks link in email for 20%, it will auto apply the 20% discount to the products shown.


4. In the add to cart section on right side - we should have a Single Bottle / 3-Pack for the option on the top in place of the One Time Purchase / Subscribe and Save. 3-Pack option will just have all products in bundle but in qty of 3 and have an automatic additional 15% discount applied, just as on the rest of our product pages for 3 bottle purchases. Please let me know if more clarity is needed on this points.


5. For the attached image "HUmann product" - We will need to create a separate shorter description for each product that will fit in without having the ... at the end. How many characters can we have in this section before it will cut off?


6. In the attached "HUmann product" image Humann has "Nutrition Facts" which pulls up the Nutirtion panel image when clicked. - Is it possible for us to have a link "Product Details" that pulls up center page image carousel of the product so they can cycle through and see all sides of the bottle?


7. Change page background color to be the white color just like the top section of our mybrightcore.com product pages, instead of the mint color.


8. Round all corners to 5px.


9. In attached "Brightcore Section" image, change the header section background color to the mint color and change text to dark green.

description:
Please refer to the concept below for better understanding.


Concept:

1. The person who is selected and the job is offered from our end, is required to complete the documentation process.

2. Currently, it is a physical process.

3. We need to make a module where, we provide either a URL or Username/ Password to the hired person, where he can go & upload documents

4. When he/she submits all the documents, an email should be delivered to him/ her that "Documents are successfully submitted, It is subject to approval by the HR department, Alian Software." and another email to HR dept about submission of documents.

5. HR dept can verify Approve/ Reject the documents.

6. If all documents are approved, then an email should be delivered that "All documents are verified, the documentation process is completed."

7. Once documents are verified, it should be locked, so no one can remove or change the document.

8. If any document is rejected, then the candidate should upload the documents again.



Please find the list of documents below.

1. A Passport size Photo (UI/UX team should decide the upload size)*

2. Aadhar Card (Front & Back)*

3. PAN Card*

4. COVID Vaccine Certificate*

5. Marksheets (From std.10 upto Bachelors & Masters)*

6. Last 6 months of Salary Slips*

7. Last 6 months of Salary account statement*

8. Offer Letter / Experience Letter / Promotion / Increment Letter from Previous Employer*


(Document with * shall be kept as required)


Suggestion : Give an option to admin, where two options shall be given.

              1. Fresher (where doc no. 1 to 5 displayed)

              2. Experienced (Where doc no. 1 to 8 displayed)
